decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used for the front and rear elevations of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used on the existing building.  Details of the brick to be used for the side elevations of the extension shall be submitted to and shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced, and the development shall only be carried out as approved.
Condition : 3 - No additional door or window openings shall be provided in the external walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the rear extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The existing front parking area shown on the submitted plan No.MAR/06/02 received 23rd May 2006 shall be retained.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to house together with front porch
